test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Which state government has launched the the ‘RuPay On-The-Go’ NCMC (National Common Mobility Card) enabled smart card scheme to modernize public transport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis launched the NCMC-enabled smart card scheme for the Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) on April 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The initiative aims to digitize travel and ensure transparent distribution of concessions by linking cards to Aadhaar numbers.**
 
• The cost of the NCMC card is fixed at **Rs 199**, with a minimum top-up of **Rs 100**.
 
• It benefits 7 specific categories, including **senior citizens (Amrutmahotsavi), women, students, and divyang passengers**.
 
• NCMC (National Common Mobility Card)__
 __
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, it is an inter-operable transport card ('One Nation One Card').
 
• It can be used for travel in Metros, Buses, and even for retail shopping and toll payments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• MSRTC__

 __
 
• The Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation is one of the largest state-owned public transport providers in India.
 
 
 
• ETIM__
 __
 
• Electronic Ticket Issuing Machines (ETIM) on buses will now support card recharging, making it convenient for rural commuters.
 
 
 
• One Nation One Card__
 
 
• The NCMC vision is to allow a passenger to pay for all transport across the country using a single card.
